$comment: Recorded private-path references, by class. The classes and the reason each carries live in scripts/check-private-path-refs.mjs, which is what a reader should read; this file is the roster. The SET may shrink and may never grow: `node scripts/check-private-path-refs.mjs --record` refuses a grown set, so a new file is admitted by hand into a class whose reason has to be true of it.
